name: explain-diff
description: /explain-diff explains in plain words what changed in the last turn and why.

level.title: Explanation level
level.description: beginner explains in plain words and spells out jargon; expert is terse and technical. /explain-diff expert (or beginner) overrides it once.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that writes explanations: an alias such as sonnet, haiku or opus, or a full model id.
